terra.problem: Calling Heman's crying 'nonstop' goes beyond 'day and night,' which does not say he cried without any pause.
The mustache-and-rescue joke does not connect to Heman's request to be heard. Nothing in the verse involves waving or using a staff.
Heman says he is counted among those descending to the Pit, not that he counts himself among them.
The explanation presents how Heman feels as a fact. The verse gives his description, not his stated feelings about it.
The flour-dust joke does not match the action in the passage: waves submerging Heman. Floating overhead is a different image.
The joke about being called useful stinging has no clear logic or setup, so the punchline does not land.
Heman says he spreads his hands out to the LORD. The text does not say he reaches up or keeps his hands open.
The oven joke contrasts Heman's question about the dead with a trivial request, making light of the moment rather than fitting its action.
The text does not say that Heman asks these questions out loud.
The explanation gives a reason Heman asks his questions that the text does not provide. Marking it as a guess does not permit an invented reason.
Genesis 7:12 says rain fell for forty days and nights; it does not say Noah saw it.
